zero_draft_routing_fix.finding: Native metadata discards previous accepted-token offset when total NEW draft count is zero. Native align postprocess does not rebase state inside a block. Regression reproduces stale-state output; retaining the stateful route restores exact output and accepted state without adding input tokens.
zero_draft_routing_fix.current_fix: Use authoritative CPU is_prefilling plus actual query lengths to route every decoder row through accepted-state selection, regardless of absent/negative/stale current-draft hints; keep genuine one-token prefills as prefills.

zero_draft_routing_fix.caller_integration: Worker-local builder wrapper supplies current owning model-runner acceptance buffer when native caller omits it. Native runner updates this buffer after every sampling step.
